description: Asks which operator spellings the expression parser accepts and what they return: <> and the other not-equal and less-or-equal spellings (!=, ^=, ><, =<, =>, ==, <=>), chained comparisons, the logical words in mixed case, && and ||, Is Null forms and their negations, Not with Between, In and Like, Mod in three cases and %, //, \ and ** , ^ with negative and fractional operands, unary signs on Boolean, and & and + with Null. Each expression is its own snapshot SELECT expr, VarType(expr) FROM One, followed by DBEngine.Errors. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
